name: apollo
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Apollo instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Apollo tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Apollo through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Apollo Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Apollo only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
